notes.title: October Update
notes.content:
Here is a list of fixes/improvements for the latest update:

- Reduced size/spawn rate of props that were causing visual clutter
- Added an option to turn reduce/turn off mouse smoothing
- Rewrote the character controller physics for on air movement
- Increased platform size on platforming puzzles
- Added additional checks/removal for props on the exit hole, including the destructible pipes
- Fixed Steam achievements not triggering for some people.

notes.title: New Weapons Update
notes.content:
Hey,
    This is the biggest update yet. 
    It includes a lot of content and several improvements to the game's experience. 
    Here is the patch list:

- Added a new currency: Diamonds. Used to buy permanent improvements.
- Added a bunch of different guns. Each with it's own sound/visual effects and specific stats / play style.
- Revamped the upgrade system. Now purchasable upgrades can be selected before being bought, or can be swapped.
- New Unlocking system. Permanent improvements can be bought at the Big Shopping Machine. These affect the efficacy of upgrades and/or modify current statuses/values.
- Added a Max FPS limiting to 60 FPS option.
- Added Firing Button Swap option.
- Added camera visual effects when using slow motion pills.
- Increased hit box detection for the Snake Bot
- Alerted enemies sound decay less with distance, so it becomes easier to know their position and if they are alerted.
- Removed tutorial. Most game mechanics are pretty straight forward now, no need to use signs / bots to find areas of interest.
- 2nd art pass on some of the 3d models.
- Balanced all the game values to fit new weapons / shopping machines costs.
- Gifts now drop items instead of money.

notes.title: New Maze Generation Update
notes.content:
Hey,

    Here is a small list of changes of this update:

-Reworked Maze Generation. The maze now is more rectangular, allowing the player to find the exit in a easier manner.
-Removed Vapetrons
-Removed Exit Signs
-Added slow motion pills
-Added exploding bombs that can be used to break obstacles or kill multiple robots
-Added Pickable Items
-Reduced tree width, so it is harder to get blocked by it
-Fixed money bouncing off the player

notes.title: Controller Support Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36714815/4b2ccb3a58a178b04d350baa0e96c2b3692f3c11.jpg[/img]

Hey guys,
    The game has controller support now. 
    Also, some other quality of life improvements were added. 
    Here is a patch list:

- Controller support, on player movement, UI navigation and icons
- Thinner tree trunks so the player doesn't collide with them as much
- The wall turret bot plays a louder warning sound, and takes longer to shoot the laser
- Bullets lost on reloading are shown dropping out of the gun.
- Money doesn't collide with bullets anymore
- Reduced Obstacles HP
- Y axis inversion option

notes.title: Early Access is here!
notes.content:
Hey!

The game is gonna be released into Early Access in a few moments from now. This is the first step in a series of things that are planned for Vapormaze. 

In the next few months, I'm going to keep updating and improving the game, based on your feedback. Here are some things you can expect up next: 

-Improve the overall design / structure to the game to fit player's feedback
-Bosses at the end of the maze
-More ability upgrades
-Improved procedural generation, including bigger non maze structures inside the maze and obstacles
-More enemy types
-New ways and tools to survive and escape the mazes
-Speed running Leaderboards
-Other quality of life improvements, such as controller support, linux and macOs support

If you have any questions, suggestions or bug reports, feel free to post it on the discussions forum!


Felipe
